title: 完结感言第29集 第18章 功成大结局
lines: 沧元图最新章节_完结感言第1页_沧元图我吃西红柿_热点小说网
《沧元图》完结了，番茄看评论，很多读者说这本书短了些，还有很多没写。
但我觉得，孟川成为元神八劫境，正是最适合结束之时。
这本书的灵感来源，是因为现实中很多为社会奉献的人们，比如专心于科学数十年的科学家们，付出生命的军人们，和罪犯做生死斗争的缉毒警，面对火海逆流而上的消防员们，冲向病毒和危险的医生们……因为这些人们付出，我们才能享受和平生活。而这些英雄们，很多人不知道他们的名字。
番茄，最想写的是沧元界那些和妖族战斗的可歌可泣的英雄们，神魔的名字，无数卷宗上凡俗的名字，他们是人族的脊梁！
孟川成劫境后，番茄最想写的就是成八劫境。
因为成八劫境……这些英雄们便可从时空长河中走出来，番茄觉得，这本书便足够圆满了。
闯荡无尽时空的故事？修行的故事？更多是孟川的爱好，享受生活了。
《沧元图》至此结束，番茄从05年开始写小说，至今也有十五年多。
最长的是《吞噬星空》，四百七十多万字，从《吞噬星空》《莽荒纪》《盘龙》《星辰变》《九鼎记》《飞剑问道》《雪鹰领主》《寸芒》《星峰传说》到如今这本《沧元图》，一共整整十本小说。
超过十五年时间，十本小说，超2800万字。
十本小说了，番茄作为作者，该有点野心，写点能完全代表自己的小说。
接下来我会休息一段时间，也会用心准备。
这一次，没确定开新书的准确时间。
我会好好准备，当准备无比充分，认定新书可以超越我所有小说的那一天起，我会开新书。
希望希望开新书时，能给大家些惊喜。

The latest chapter of Cang Yuan Tu_Final Remarks Page 1_Cang Yuan Tu I Eat Tomatoes_Hot Novel Network
"Cang Yuan Tu" is finished. Looking at the comments on Tomato, many readers said that the book is a bit short and there is still a lot left to be written.
But I think that when Meng Chuan becomes the Eight Tribulations Realm of Yuanshen, it is the most suitable time for it to end.
The inspiration for this book comes from the many people who have dedicated themselves to society in reality, such as scientists who have devoted themselves to science for decades, soldiers who have sacrificed their lives, anti-narcotics policemen who fight life and death with criminals, firefighters who face the sea of ​​​​fire and go upstream, and doctors who rush to viruses and dangers... Because of these people's efforts, we can enjoy a peaceful life. And these heroes, many people don't know their names.
Tomato, what I want to write about the most is the heroic heroes who fought against the monsters in Cangyuan Realm, the names of gods and demons, and the mortal names in countless files. They are the backbone of the human race!
After Meng Chuan reached the realm of tribulation, what Tomato wanted to write about most was the realm of eight tribulations.
Because of the Eight Tribulations Realm... these heroes can walk out of the long river of time and space. Tomato feels that this book is complete enough.
A story about traveling through endless time and space? The story of spiritual practice? It's more of Meng Chuan's hobby and enjoying life.
This is the end of "Cang Yuan Tu". Tomato started writing novels in 2005, and it has been more than fifteen years now.
The longest one is "Swallowing the Starry Sky", with more than 4.7 million words. From "Swallowing the Starry Sky", "The Wilderness", "Coiling Dragon", "Star Transformation", "Jiuding Ji", "Flying Sword Asking", "Snow Eagle Lord", "Cun Mang", "Star Peak Legend" to the current "Cang Yuan Tu", there are ten novels in total.
Over fifteen years, ten novels with over 28 million words.
Ten novels have been written. As an author, Tomato should be a little ambitious and write novels that fully represent himself.
I will take some time off next and prepare carefully.
This time, the exact time for opening the new book has not been determined.
I will prepare well, and from the day when I am fully prepared and believe that the new book can surpass all my novels, I will start a new book.
I hope I can give you some surprises when I open a new book.
